Definition: something born, i.e. a lad or offspring
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses yeled where it means a child, a lad. In Genesis 4:23, a young man to my hurt, and it appears again in Exodus 1:17.
TheologicalSignificance: A child is at the centre of both verses, and I believe yeled reminds me that God sees the young before the world does.
